items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: You see, my mother taught us how to...

ctx.x: Did you have much exposure to church music yourself?

Yeah! You see, my mother taught us how to... See, I could read music when I first started playing. I know "do" was C and "re" was E, like that. Then I found out that when playing the horn, it's the same thing -- it's C-D-E-F-G-A-B-C. It was the same scale. So I liked that. Didn't have too hard a time learning, because I had a pretty good start, background. Then all I had to do was get out there and blow. Man, when I first started, man, you could hear me blowing for two miles -- on that carnival! Yeah, you had to…
We got on that show, and we went everywhere. We went traveling around. The show closed in Palatka, Florida.
